text.en:
Any general or special law to the contrary notwithstanding, the President may, on his own
initiative or upon recommendation of the Fiscal Incentives Review Board, modify and/or revise any fiscal
incentive granted under any statute when any of the following conditions exist;
(a) When it is reasonably evident that the incentives granted are no longer adequate, necessary or appropriate.
(b) When there is need to modify incentive privileges in the light of technological, economic and social
(c) When there is need to redesign the tax incentive schemes to obviate unemployment and avoid economic
and social dislocation.

The authority granted under Section one hereof shall be exercised on, but not limited to the
following statutes enumerated, to wit:
(a) Republic Act Numbers 660 (as amended by Republic Act Number 728), 720 (as amended by Republic Act
Numbers 3128 and 5930 and Presidential Decree Number 69), 1407 (as amended by Presidential Decree
Numbers 664 and 764), 1910, 2067 (as amended by Republic Act Number 3589) 2369 (as amended by

amended; and
(e) Batasang Pambansa Numbers 21 and 44.

Any modification of incentive pursuant to this law shall have prospective application: Provided,
that, all rights previously vested in the aforesaid laws shall not be affected thereby.

All laws, acts, decrees, orders and ordinances inconsistent with any of the provisions of this
Decree are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
